name: CoreDirective Bot
description: Telegram operations agent fronted by n8n workflows. Dispatches ADHD command, finance, and status queries through the master orchestrator. High sensitivity because the same channel surfaces every orchestrator action to the operator.

skills.name: ADHD Command
skills.description: Routes an ADHD commander request to the n8n ADHD workflow and returns the response.

skills.name: Finance Query
skills.description: Routes a finance manager request to the n8n finance workflow and returns the response.

skills.name: Status Report
skills.description: Returns the consolidated system status for the connected stack.
